name: Nicholas Rieveldt
original_name: ニコラス リーヴェルト
source:
He is the mood-maker of the team. He has a courageous personality and often lightens the mood inside the team. He has enough physical strength to use a shotgun with just one hand and is extremely strong when it comes to fighting. He escaped from the city his cousin Richard controls and met up with the team.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.zombiekaigai&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
